hero.title: The New Era of Artificial Intelligence
hero.subtitle: The Age of Agent-Driven Applications. Purposeful Intelligence.
hero.description: SentiensApps is an ecosystem of applications where each neural network becomes your tool for learning, dialogue, and problem-solving.

philosophy.title: The Sentiens Philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: Three principles that define every decision we make and every line of code we write.

pillars.title: Profound Meaning
pillars.description: We create not just chatbots, but holistic personalities and specialized intelligences.

pillars.title: Flawless Utility
pillars.description: Every application solves a specific task — from learning to creativity.

pillars.title: Living Ecosystem
pillars.description: All our applications are built on a common technological foundation, ensuring the stability, security, and continuous evolution of each one.

technology.title: The Sentiens Engine
technology.subtitle: Architecture of Consciousness
technology.description: A technological platform that transforms language models into autonomous, purposeful, and trainable agents.
technology.key_message: Our development is a thoughtful architecture that turns large language models (LLMs) into more capable and useful agents. We equip them with memory of past interactions, the ability to set goals within tasks, and unique personality traits. Our aim is to move beyond simple chat.

pillars.title: Agent Core
pillars.subtitle: Agency Layer
pillars.preview: Decision-making core: Each of our agents operates through an autonomous cycle: Perception → Context Analysis → Planning → Action → Memory Storage.

dynamic_goals.title: Dynamic Goal Setting
dynamic_goals.content: Agents don't just respond to requests. They formulate and adjust short-term and long-term goals within a given mission: to educate a user, support research, or solve a problem.

tools.title: Toolkit (Tools)
tools.content: Agents can safely interact with external systems: retrieve data, perform calculations, manage environmental elements.

pillars.title: Mnemosyne Layer
pillars.subtitle: Layer of Memory and Context
pillars.preview: We go beyond the short context window. An agent possesses working, long-term, and procedural memory.

memory_types.title: Vector and Hierarchical Memory
memory_types.content:
Working Memory — the flow of the current dialogue
Long-term Memory — a vector knowledge base about the world and interaction history
Procedural Memory — memorized successful behavior patterns and solutions

self_vectorization.title: Self-vectorization of Experience
self_vectorization.content: A key innovation. The agent automatically analyzes and stores the essence of each interaction into its memory, forming a constantly growing "personality" and experience base.

pillars.title: Persona Framework
pillars.subtitle: Behavior and Role Model Layer
pillars.preview: Not just a prompt: This is a complex system of constraints, values, vocabulary, and communication styles.

deep_role.title: Deep Role Model
deep_role.content: The system "dresses" the base model in a coherent and profound role, creating a unique digital personality with a consistent character.

adaptive_behavior.title: Adaptive Behavior
adaptive_behavior.content: The model can adjust its tone, depth of explanations, and interaction strategy depending on the user and context.

pillars.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
pillars.subtitle: Collaboration Layer
pillars.preview: Our platform allows for the creation of not just individual bots, but ecosystems of interacting agents.

sync_worlds.title: Synchronized Worlds
sync_worlds.content: Agents can exchange messages, request assistance, challenge each other's arguments, or collaboratively solve complex problems.

swarm_intelligence.title: Swarm Intelligence
swarm_intelligence.content: In certain scenarios, a group of agents managed by an orchestrator can solve tasks beyond the capability of a single model.

result.title: The Result
result.content: We deliver not "chatbots," but ready-to-use, autonomous, context-aware AI solutions that can be integrated into any product, educational course, or digital environment.

tech_stack.title: Technology Stack
tech_stack.content: We build on leading LLMs (OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, open-source solutions), but our value lies in the layers of agent logic, advanced prompt engineering (prompt/AGI chaining), and orchestration systems that are our intellectual property.

audience.title: Audience
audience.subtitle: Who is this for?
audience.description: Our technology creates a new class of digital entities. We solve problems where a simple answer is not enough—where meaningful dialogue, guided simulation, or live interaction is required.

cards.title: For Educational Platforms
cards.problem: Online learning is often passive and does not account for the individual context of the student.
cards.solution: Agents as personal mentors and interactive "knowledge characters" that teach through dialogue, not monologue.

cards.title: For Those Seeking Inspiration and Dialogue
cards.problem: Text and voice interfaces remain impersonal. They lack the depth, context, and character needed for substantive communication, creativity, or intellectual debate.
cards.solution: Agents as conversational partners and co-creators. They sustain deep topics, remember the flow of conversation, offer unexpected perspectives, and communicate within the framework of a vivid, consistent personality.

cards.title: For Those Who Value Personalization and Depth
cards.problem: One-off chat sessions do not accumulate interaction experience. Each dialogue starts from a blank slate, without considering your history, goals, and preferences.
cards.solution: Agents that learn with you. They remember context, adapt their communication style, and over time become truly "yours"—understanding digital companions.

cards.title: For Those Who Learn and Grow
cards.problem: Standard courses and learning materials are static and do not adapt to your pace, knowledge gaps, and learning style. There is no patient mentor to guide you along an individual path.
cards.solution: Your personal AI mentor. An agent that assesses your current level, remembers your mistakes, adjusts difficulty, and builds a personalized path to mastery—whether it's a language, a skill, or an entire field of knowledge.

cards.title: For Everyone Ready for a New Format of Interaction with Technology
cards.problem: Most interfaces are impersonal. You communicate with an algorithm that doesn't remember past conversations and lacks character, making the dialogue superficial and technical.
cards.solution: Meet an AI with individuality. A digital entity you want to have a conversation with. Our agents are not just programs, but interlocutors with character, memory, and their own manner of communication, turning interaction into something truly alive and engaging.
